slots.argument: Rome is a walkable stage set, not a transit grid — the first image should make the reader feel the compact, golden-lit core they're about to learn to cross on foot.
slots.shot: Wide golden-hour view over the historic-centre rooftops or a light-washed piazza with the dome-and-terracotta skyline; sense of a dense, walkable heart.
slots.query: Rome historic center rooftops golden hour

slots.chapter: The ground: a city you can walk across
slots.argument: The core is small and the walking IS the sightseeing — a pedestrian lane opening onto a monument proves the thesis better than any map.
slots.shot: A narrow cobbled Roman lane framing a sudden view of a landmark (Pantheon portico, a fountain) at its end; few or no faces.
slots.query: Rome narrow cobblestone street Pantheon view

slots.argument: The ancient cluster is one connected half-day on unshaded stone — empty early light makes the 'Forum first, at opening' verdict visceral.
slots.shot: The Roman Forum or Palatine in low early sunlight, long shadows, no crowds; ruins receding toward the Colosseum.
slots.query: Roman Forum sunrise empty golden light

slots.argument: Trastevere is the base you pick when evenings outrank proximity — ivy, lantern light and a table outdoors is the trade it offers.
slots.shot: A Trastevere lane at dusk: ivy-draped ochre walls, warm lamplight, trattoria tables; atmospheric, no recognizable faces.
slots.query: Trastevere Rome evening ivy lantern light

slots.argument: The Pantheon survives as a building, not a ruin — the shaft of light through the oculus is the wonder the reader is buying a slot for.
slots.shot: Interior of the Pantheon dome with the oculus beam falling on the coffered ceiling or marble floor; upward or across.
slots.query: Pantheon Rome oculus interior light beam

slots.chapter: Eating: the rule that outlives the list
slots.argument: Roman food is cucina povera done brilliantly — a plate of one of the four classics anchors the 'walk ninety seconds off the sight' payoff.
slots.shot: Close overhead of an authentic Roman pasta (cacio e pepe / carbonara / amatriciana) on a plain trattoria table; no branding.
slots.query: cacio e pepe Roman pasta trattoria overhead

slots.argument: The payoff of deciding everything in advance is the aimless lit-core walk home — the closing image should be the reward, not a monument checklist.
slots.shot: A floodlit fountain or piazza at night with the wet travertine glowing, a few distant figures, the city quiet and warm.
